# Pay Guide - Nurses Award [MA000034]
## Published 17 July 2026
**When do the rates in the pay guide apply from?** The first full pay period starting on or after 01 August 2026.

**What is in this pay guide?** It’s a summary of the award rates. Go to the award for information about coverage, classifications, conditions and the operation of minimum rates, allowances, penalty rates and overtime.

**Where can I go for more information?** Our Pay and Conditions Tool can help you work out pay rates, leave, notice and redundancy minimum entitlements based on the information you provide. Our website also provides useful templates, best practice guides, fact sheets and online courses.

# Nurses Award [MA000034]
Learn how to calculate pay rates and check entitlements from [Find pay rates and entitlements](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000034-summary#find-pay-rates-and-entitlements).

## Find pay rates and entitlements
Use our tools and resources to:

- [calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000034-summary#calculate-pay-rates-penalty-rates-and-allowances)
- [work out notice periods and redundancy pay](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000034-summary#work-out-notice-periods-and-redundancy-pay)

### Find your award
If you’re not sure of your award, use our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/pay-calculator).

### Calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances
You can calculate pay rates, penalty rates and allowances using our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/pay-calculator).

Prefer a single document? You can also download the pay guide for your award from our [Pay guides](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/minimum-wages/pay-guides) page.

### Work out notice periods and redundancy pay
You can find out how much notice and redundancy pay is required under your award using our [Pay and Conditions Tool](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/ending-employment/notice-redundancy-calculator).
